title: Suyetchai MLA
desc: When Nambirajan's sister's would-be father-in-law insults him and challenges him to amass name and wealth, Nambirajan strives hard to become a powerful politician.

title: Nepali
desc: After constant harassment by a police officer, Priya, Karthik's wife, ends her life. Soon, a deeper conspiracy comes into play when he is jailed for the murder of the policeman.

title: Andha 7 Naatkal
desc: When Vasanthi's husband, Dr Anand, learns that she was forcefully married to him, he decides to reunite her with her lover. However, Vasanthi soon falls for him and accepts him as her husband.

title: Samundi
desc: Samundi and his mother move into a nearby hamlet to live peacefully. However, terror strikes them once again through the local goon, who spoiled his sister's life.

title: Citizen
desc: Anthony assumes several identities and kidnaps three government officials in order to succeed in his secret mission. However, a CBI officer sets out to find the real identity of the kidnapper.

title: Mambattiyaan
desc: After a young man's father is murdered, he turns to a life of violence and revenge. However, his twisted sense of justice is not appreciated by the police who are determined to capture him.

title: Mayanginen Thayanginen
desc: Muthukumar, a taxi driver, falls in love with a telephone operator. However, the girl's traumatic past changes his life forever.

title: Mittai
desc: Surya and Arun are best friends in college, who unintentionally fall in love with the same woman, Pooja, which causes their relationship to get strained.

title: Ranuva Veeran
desc: Raghu returns to his village and learns that people are being terrorised by a notorious gang. His world comes crashing down when he realises that his sister is in love with the leader of the gang.
